status: Synthetic mixed-fleet routing scenarios. Account names and plan tiers are fictional; explicit quota capacities and model calibration values are independent test inputs, not subscription entitlements or a description of any person or machine.

harness_factors.basis: Absolute harness quality on weighted fit and ability. Default 1.0. This does not replace harness_order. That list is a sibling-only preference (same account, model, effort and action): the best sibling keeps its score, and the order flips by work_kind and interaction style. The equivalent coefficient is harness_order_factor = 1 - harness_step * places_behind / (harness_factor * weighted fit and ability), which subtracts exactly harness_step per place.

opportunity_exchange.basis: Quality-versus-quota exchange, and the only rate window_cost reads (via exchange_rate). score_per_displaced_usd is 0.012 score per USD of expected displaced subscription capacity; score_per_displaced_worker_hour is 0.06 score per displaced worker-hour, only when a window has no USD capacity. One score point is about $83.33 of displaced USD, or 16.67 worker-hours. Top-level shortage_loss_per_usd and shortage_loss_per_worker_hour are a deprecated fallback used only when the field here is absent. If both are set and differ, this object wins and the plan warns that the old key was ignored.

subjective.basis: Gemini 4 Argon leads in divergent/expansive thinking and architectural innovation (formulating schemes, proposing creative research); Claude Opus 5.5 leads in architectural landing rigor and comprehensive global thinking; GPT 6.1 Sol lacks global vision (penalized on context_scale=3 / cross-module architecture) but has high concrete module implementation precision (context_scale=1, code_complexity=1..2).

scoring.basis: Task demand is continuous: required_ability = ability_floor + critical_headroom + property_span * depth/4 * property (scoring.demand), not a depth-to-effort table. Supply is model tier x the model's own effort_curves coefficient, so any effort of any model may serve any task; medium/low are offered whenever tier + curve still clears the floor, and xhigh/max are chosen only when the demand exceeds what High saturates. Ability saturates at the required ability; minimum-sufficient work prices excess ability above required_ability + saturation_span, scaled by the effort's burn and exempting GUI/frontend at depth >= 2. High precision earns high_precision_effort_weight times positive effort ability gain above High. Opportunity cost includes displaced demand in USD plus smooth weekly scarcity below scarcity_usable_ref_pct. Observed demand behind schedule is floored at demand_pace_floor_ratio times linear pace. Near a reset, surplus earns reset_bonus_max (1.2) and waives opportunity cost, extra_effort_penalty and overqualification in proportion to sunk_weight, so expiring quota is converted into higher thinking effort. Fast-capable models (Sol/Astra) enable fast mode (2x burn) during pre-reset sprints (sunk_weight >= fast_sprint_sunk_threshold) or when speed is requested and usable quota after 2x burn remains >= fast_plentiful_usable_pct.

demand.basis: Task side of the match: required_ability = ability_floor[difficulty] + critical_headroom + property_span * (reasoning_depth / 4) * property_load, where property_load is the weighted mean of the task properties (code_complexity/3, (context_scale-1)/2, (divergence-1)/2, (hallucination_risk-1)/2, min(error_cost,2)-1). Work without a profile uses its difficulty as the depth and default_load as the load. Each property capability requirement also grows depth_coupling per depth above 2. Supply side: model tier x that model's own effort_curves coefficient. A candidate below required_ability pays shortfall_weight per tier point (high-precision work that is not critical adds precision_headroom to its requirement); effort above High earns ability credit only up to required_ability; a window about to reset with surplus quota waives the extra burn and adds up to sprint_effort_weight for the effort step above High.

effort_curves.basis: Per-model effort curves. `ability` is the change in tier from High (or `ability_mult`: tier multiplier per effort); `burn` is the quota multiplier (0.7 = High; or `burn_mult`: multiplier relative to High). Effective ability = model tier x its effort coefficient; the task side is depth x property difficulty (scoring.demand), never a fixed depth-to-effort table. Efforts a model has no entry for fall back to the policy-wide `effort_ability` and `effort_burn`. `ability` is the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index change from High at each effort (independent; leaderboard of 2026-10-09) times 0.1 tier per index point; `burn` is 0.7 times the Artificial Analysis cost per task relative to High, so it carries the longer runs higher efforts need. Each entry names its `calibration_source`; recalibrate an entry by replacing its numbers and source together. Grok has no medium or max entry, Flash no low, xhigh or max.

capability_policy.precedence: Honor explicit user instructions and specialist requirements. Preserve the Dot closed-loop exception outside the subscription auction. Establish quality, tools, permissions and runtime eligibility. Gemini 3.8 Flash is not the preferred coder: its quota is very large, so simple coding-plus-tool-call work (difficulty `routine`) goes to it first when it has usable capacity, and anything harder is not eligible for it (the `hard` ability floor sits above Flash); then balance quota/reset/demand. Preserve the route's earlier ordering as fallback. Other rankings remain soft priors.

execution_preference.gemini-3.8-flash-high: Routine coding & tool-execution volume sink (tier 3.0); barred above routine difficulty.
execution_preference.claude-sonnet-5-5: Primary exploration, research-packet, and multi-hop synthesis workhorse (BrowseComp #1, Bug Hunt Max #1).
execution_preference.gpt-6.1-sol: Concrete single-module implementation & localized debugging specialist (module_precision 0.95, $2.19/h calibration); lacks global vision (global_rigor 0.25) so penalized on global or cross-module architectural work.
execution_preference.gemini-4-argon-high: Divergent thinking, expansive ideation, and architectural innovation leader (divergence 0.96); prioritized when formulating schemes/plans or proposing creative research.
execution_preference.claude-opus-5-5: Apex architect for cross-module architectural landing rigor, comprehensive holistic thinking (global_rigor 0.98), critical changes, and visual inspection.
execution_preference.grok-bot: Same ability tier and vectors as claude-opus-5-5 by synthetic alignment, not a measured benchmark. Remote text channel still excludes local, visual, GUI and file transfer. Cost and quota stay unknown.
execution_preference.gpt-6-astra: OpenAI frontier model & #1 GUI/computer-use specialist ($22.75/h calibration).
execution_preference.dot: Free Astra-tier remote worker via dot2api for any non-local, non-visual work.

resource_balancing.rule: Match task profile to minimum-sufficient tier; spend free/expiring or high-headroom pools first; reserve Opus and Astra for coupled/frontier/critical or specialized GUI/visual work.

capability_policy.delegation: Send work to Dot whenever the assignment can be handed over and its result returned as files or text: Dot has its own computer, receives code/files in the packet (`run_dot_task.py --file <path> --apply-to .`), fetches public data itself and takes other data through the verified hand-offs (dot-subagent). Ordinary file creation or modification is NOT a reason for `needs.local_only`. Callers should mark the work `needs.local_only` (with a required `needs.local_only_reason` naming the concrete local dependency) when it must run against this machine's local tools/daemons/git/test environment, local secrets, live logged-in accounts, or multi-step parent interaction. When the caller leaves `needs.local_only` unset, trust the classifier's `profile.local_only` judgment and carry its `reason` into `needs.local_only_reason` without a second reason gate; explicit caller values take precedence. Compare the parent's actual model, effort, tools and context with specialist needs for every other assignment. Delegate a bounded specialist question or artifact when its capability or independent perspective adds value, even without parallelism. If the parent already meets the specialist need, staying local is valid unless independent work is requested. Do not hand off just because a model name appears.

dot_execution.scope: A bounded assignment Dot can finish end to end and return as a completed text deliverable.
dot_execution.basis: Choose Dot only when it can close the loop.

web_research.scope: Gather, check and organize information from the open web or other public sources on Dot's own computer, and return a written, sourced result: surveys of options or vendors, current prices, specs or versions, documentation and changelog lookups, fact-checks, news and background roundups, comparison tables.
web_research.effort: As supported and justified by the task
web_research.basis: Scores decide: Dot has its own computer and is unmetered, suitable for gathering and organizing public info.

text_in_text_out.scope: Self-contained work whose whole input fits in the packet and whose deliverable is text returned to the parent: drafting, rewriting, translating, summarizing, critiquing, comparing, explaining, and reviewing the logic of a document given in full (mark that `hard`).
text_in_text_out.effort: As supported and justified by the task
text_in_text_out.basis: Scores decide: text in, text out is Dot's class, and Dot is a candidate on every route.

exploration_analysis.scope: Explore and analyze material on this machine and return findings as text, with light or no code: map how a codebase or system works, trace where and why something happens, read logs, configs, data files or documents, run read-only commands and throwaway scripts to measure something, audit or compare options against the local evidence, and check a document against the code, configuration or data it describes.
exploration_analysis.effort: High by default; xhigh when the analysis is coupled or the evidence is large and conflicting.
exploration_analysis.role: explorer or analyst (findings to the parent)

research_packet.scope: Run a defined quantitative experiment, evaluation benchmark, simulation, backtest or data analysis pipeline on this machine's data. Use existing tooling or bounded experiment scripts, compare named variants against a baseline, verify statistical results and report metrics, uncertainty and reproducible artifacts.
research_packet.effort: High by default; xhigh when the discrimination chain is long or the readings conflict.
research_packet.role: research worker (single owner of the packet)

self_contained_code.scope: Self-contained code and validation work whose whole input fits in the packet (the spec, interfaces and any existing source it must match; keep it to about 40,000 characters) and whose deliverable is new files with their unit tests, or a report of numbers, returned as text: a module and its tests, a script, a data-processing, backtest or validation routine.
self_contained_code.effort: As supported and justified by the task
self_contained_code.basis: Self-contained code route suitable for remote execution with tests.

visual_analysis.scope: Interpret screenshots, charts, diagrams, spatial layouts, image evidence or visual discrepancies; distinct from writing frontend code.
visual_analysis.effort: Opus high or xhigh, Astra high, Argon high, Sol high, Sonnet high, Flash high
visual_analysis.basis: Visual ability order: Opus 5.5 > Astra > Argon > Sol > Sonnet > Flash; capacity decides among them in that order.

direction_reasoning.scope: Deep reasoning and discussion of solution direction, competing architectures, assumptions, causal explanations, or which problem to solve.
direction_reasoning.effort: Argon/Opus high for worker sessions; highest available Pro effort in the web UI at frontier difficulty.
direction_reasoning.basis: Gemini 4 Argon leads in divergent thinking and architectural innovation for formulating schemes; frontier advisory consultations use ChatGPT Pro.

complex_build_plan.scope: Turn an agreed direction into a repository-grounded multi-system build plan: dependencies, interfaces, staged migrations, sequencing, validation and rollback.
complex_build_plan.effort: Argon/Opus high for worker sessions; highest available Pro effort in the web UI at frontier difficulty.
complex_build_plan.basis: Gemini 4 Argon is prioritized when formulating plans/schemes; Opus 5.5 backs comprehensive architectural rigor; frontier web advisor uses ChatGPT Pro.

general_implementation.scope: Implement an agreed plan, maintain production features, refactor bounded code or deliver ordinary repository changes.
general_implementation.effort: Flash/Argon high for every worker packet; level is encoded in the model ID. Use the original supported medium/high efforts on fallbacks.
general_implementation.basis: Flash is listed first only as the volume sink for simple (`routine`) work: its quota is very large, and the `hard` ability floor keeps it of

debug_review.scope: Subtle bug diagnosis, regression analysis, review of code and diffs, invariants, test-driven repairs and checking existing behavior.
debug_review.effort: Supported high/xhigh on the models listed first, more for coupled difficult failures; Argon/Flash high when assigned.
debug_review.role: reviewer or debugging worker, as assigned
debug_review.basis: Review and diagnosis are judgment work, not the simple coding-plus-tool-call work that goes to Flash, so it is listed last.

frontend_implementation.scope: Write UI components, interactions, animations and styling from the accepted design; visual evidence inspection is a separate visual_analysis task when material.
frontend_implementation.effort: Flash/Argon high for every worker packet; supported high/medium on fallbacks.
frontend_implementation.basis: Flash is listed first only as the volume sink for simple (`routine`) UI changes (its quota is very large); harder frontend work requires higher capability.

bounded_bulk_work.scope: Homogeneous small changes, independent extraction or inventory, boilerplate and fixed transformations with explicit acceptance.
bounded_bulk_work.effort: Flash/Argon high for every worker packet; supported medium/high on fallbacks.
bounded_bulk_work.basis: Flash first as the volume sink for homogeneous simple coding/tool work (its quota is very large); harder homogeneous work uses higher tiers.

tool_execution.scope: A bounded outcome primarily requiring file, shell, browser, API or other tool calls, with direction and authorized actions already established.
tool_execution.effort: Flash/Argon high for every worker packet; level is encoded in the model ID. Fallback effort follows assignment difficulty and runtime support.
tool_execution.basis: Flash first as the volume sink for simple tool-call work (its quota is very large; not a quality ranking).

computer_use.scope: Operate a graphical computer or app through screenshots, mouse and keyboard (computer use): GUI-only applications, desktop or browser flows with no API, clicking through settings.
computer_use.effort: High on the models listed (Astra, Sol); unlisted vision models rank by their `gui` capability. Default difficulty is `hard` (Flash closed); a profiled small GUI task (reasoning_depth 1) or an explicit `routine` opens it to Flash and Sol.
computer_use.basis: Codex scores higher at computer use, and the router chooses it without explicit manual naming.

other_or_mixed.effort: As supported and justified by the task
other_or_mixed.basis: Parent judgment with task evidence; no mandatory Pro-to-Fable-to-coder pipeline.

limits: These capability preferences are not permission to delegate or transfer data.
Designated specialist routes must not be replaced with a cheaper model merely to balance quota. Report unavailable specialist capability and continue independent feasible work.
The usage snapshot's provider/account usage does not prove per-model availability or ChatGPT Pro web quota. Fable and Opus may share Claude limits; inspect applicable windows.
Metered API access, including any harness funded by it, is only eligible after no suitable subscription remains available.
dot_execution is not a subscription model and is not entered in the quota auction.
